Add the pure model layer for self-hosted sharing relays (blueprint/sharing-redesign), replacing the Cloudflare tunnel/Access model.

`sharing_model.py` holds the workspace-hostname coordinate scheme (`<service>.<host-id>.<user-id>.<region>.<content-domain>`, full untruncated ids, per-user registrable-site isolation), opaque relay-token minting/hashing, the per-user shared-workspace quota, and the frps server-plugin authorization decision (`Login`/`NewProxy` only): a workspace's relay token may register only its own bare domain and wildcard, so one workspace's frpc cannot claim another's hostname on a shared relay. Migration `018_sharing.sql` adds the `shares` and `relay_tokens` tables.

Delete the Cloudflare tunnel/Access/Workers-KV sharing stack from the connector: the `/tunnels/*` endpoints (tunnel CRUD, services, auth policies, service tokens) and `POST /sharing/enable`, the Cloudflare tunnel/Access/KV/service-token/DNS-CNAME API wrappers, tunnel naming/policy helpers, tunnel-token Bearer auth (`authenticate_request` is SuperTokens-only now), and the `max_tunnels` / `max_services_per_tunnel` quota entitlements (migration `020_drop_tunnel_entitlements.sql` drops the columns from `plans` and `account_entitlements`). Cloudflare R2 (buckets, keys, sweeps) and the DNS token used for ACME DNS-01 are unchanged; self-hosted sharing (`/shares/*`, relay tokens, broker) is the replacement.

Remove the Cloudflare-lifecycle release test (`test_remote_service_connector.py`) whose subject no longer exists, and the tunnel/Access/KV fakes from the test utilities.
